cards.title: Visitor flow and navigation
items: The page has seven section tabs, and app.js changes the active panel without leaving the page. The initial view is Overview. (index.html:17–32, 37–37; app.js:6–32, 180–181)

The script also handles the mobile menu, left/right panel keys, and scroll-to-top behavior. At small widths, stream details collapse until tapped; IntersectionObserver reveals content cards as they enter view. (app.js:35–51, 68–99, 101–142; style.css:1060–1129, 1145–1173)

cards.title: Sorting model and destinations
items: Five color-coded streams adapt Germany’s four-stream model to Thai collection, recycling, and climate conditions; only blue residual waste goes to the municipal truck. (README.md:8–38; index.html:37–149, 155–330)
The Outbound section explains separate routes for paper, recyclables, organics, residuals, and hazardous waste, including saleng, waste-bank, app, and drop-off options. (index.html:488–619)

cards.title: Organic processing
items: Bokashi is the recommended home process for Thai kitchens: sealed fermentation, periodic liquid draining, a two-week finish, then burial in soil or a pot. (index.html:356–407)
The page compares Bokashi with composting and worm farming, and lists alternatives for homes that cannot compost on site. (index.html:410–486)

cards.title: Rules, onboarding, and browser state
items: Fines, rewards, and the onboarding checklist are in the Rules panel. The saved checkboxes are onboarding steps, not the four-week roadmap. (index.html:620–755)

Each checkbox is stored as a true/false value under an indexed check_i key in localStorage. A progress bar counts completion and is inserted above that checklist; this state is local to the visitor’s browser. (app.js:53–66, 145–177)

cards.title: Household rollout and printables
items: The four-week plan covers setup, soft launch, enforcement, and review, followed by weekly/monthly maintenance and pest guidance. (index.html:756–859; README.md:20–24)
The printable poster has bilingual Thai/English sorting labels for five streams; three bag tags tell collectors how organic, recyclable, and residual bags are sorted. (index.html:864–984)

cards.title: Fonts, hosting, and CI
items: The HTML loads the local stylesheet and Google Fonts (Sarabun and IBM Plex Mono). (index.html:7–13; README.md:44–50)

The README links to the live GitHub Pages site. GitHub Actions runs a Docker Jekyll build on pushes and pull requests to main; the workflow builds _site but contains no deployment or artifact-upload step. (README.md:6–10; .github/workflows/jekyll-docker.yml:1–19)
